object_description: compact stepped volume enclosing three zoned outdoor areas
design_condition: The concentrated placement preserves existing trees, forms three differentiated outdoor areas, and connects the new volume sensitively with neighboring buildings and the surrounding landscape.

positive.statement: The concentrated and cleverly placed structure generates three spacious, well-proportioned, zoned outdoor areas with varied uses and operational separation.
The structural setting preserves all three valuable trees and integrates them as distinctive, identity-creating elements.
The volume is compatible with the townscape and fits well with the existing pavilion buildings despite its height.
The outdoor spaces and building form interact closely, creating an attractive and protected play area.
The solution impresses with urban-planning clarity and a simple, sensitive design.
The compact, clearly structured floor plans are flexible, with no unnecessary traffic space and sensible adjoining-room arrangements.
The balanced ratio of glazing and closed wall segments provides clear arrangements and opportunities for retreat.
The compact volume and relatively simple building shape promise a high level of cost-effectiveness.
